segments.name: Health and wellness
products: body care, salon, and skin care services and products
segments.description: Operates health and wellness centers on cruise ships and in destination resorts, providing spa, fitness, aesthetics and medi-spa services and retail products to guests.
segments.evidence: The Company's Maritime and Destination Resorts operating segments are aggregated into a single reportable segment based upon similar economic characteristics, products, services, customers and delivery methods.

revenueModel.text: Cruise passengers and destination resort guests pay for services and products; cruise line and resort partners remit the amounts, net of commissions they withhold.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company has entered into agreements of varying terms with the cruise lines under which services and products are paid for by cruise passengers.
